note: 432 Park Avenue slice, building.json v1. Self-made: boxes are simplified from our own reading of an approximate public-diagram model (kept out of the repo), not surveyed. Three levels stand for tower levels 1 (lobby), 10 (residential) and 19 (open mechanical band), stacked closer than real. Plan coordinates are the tower footprint, 28.5 m square, in metres from one corner. Levels T04 to T86 are the rest of the tower at real elevations, generated by data/whole-tower-build.ts (one core per level, living-room boxes per apartment, a lift chain, doors). The demo slice L1 to L3 is hand-written and untouched. Metres and kN.
